001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.currentStatus.CGMAlertStatusResponse;
007
008@HistoryLogProps(
009    opCode = 371,
010    displayName = "CGM Alert Ack B",
011    internalName = "LID_CGM_ALERT_ACK_B"
012)
013public class CgmAlertAckDexHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
014
015    private int alertId;
016    private CGMAlertStatusResponse.CGMAlert alert;
017    private int sensorType;
018    private long ackSource;
019
020    public CgmAlertAckDexHistoryLog() {}
021    public CgmAlertAckDexHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int alertId, int sensorType, long ackSource) {
022        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
023        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, alertId, sensorType, ackSource);
024        this.alertId = alertId;
025        this.alert = CGMAlertStatusResponse.CGMAlert.fromId(alertId);
026        this.sensorType = sensorType;
027        this.ackSource = ackSource;
028
029    }
030
031    public CgmAlertAckDexHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, CGMAlertStatusResponse.CGMAlert alert, int sensorType, long ackSource) {
032        this(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, alert != null ? alert.id() : 0, sensorType, ackSource);
033        this.alert = alert;
034
035    }
036
037    public CgmAlertAckDexHistoryLog(int alertId, int sensorType, long ackSource) {
038        this(0, 0, alertId, sensorType, ackSource);
039    }
040
041    public CgmAlertAckDexHistoryLog(CGMAlertStatusResponse.CGMAlert alert, int sensorType, long ackSource) {
042        this(0, 0, alert, sensorType, ackSource);
043    }
044
045    public int typeId() {
046        return 371;
047    }
048
049    /**
050     * <table border="1">
051     * <caption>Parsed fields for CgmAlertAckDexHistoryLog:</caption>
052     * <tr><td><code>alertId</code></td><td><code>raw[10]</code></td></tr>
053     * <tr><td><code>alert</code></td><td><code>CGMAlertStatusResponse.CGMAlert.fromId(alertId)</code></td></tr>
054     * <tr><td><code>sensorType</code></td><td><code>raw[11]</code></td></tr>
055     * <tr><td><code>ackSource</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
056     * </table>
057     */
058    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
059        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
060        this.cargo = raw;
061        parseBase(raw);
062        this.alertId = raw[10];
063        this.alert = CGMAlertStatusResponse.CGMAlert.fromId(alertId);
064        this.sensorType = raw[11];
065        this.ackSource = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 14);
066
067    }
068
069    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int alertId, int sensorType, long ackSource) {
070        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
071            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(371, 0),
072            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
073            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
074            new byte[]{ (byte) alertId },
075            new byte[]{ (byte) sensorType },
076            new byte[2],
077            Bytes.toUint32(ackSource)));
078    }
079
080    public int getAlertId() {
081        return alertId;
082    }
083
084    public CGMAlertStatusResponse.CGMAlert getAlert() {
085        return alert;
086    }
087
088    /**
089     * The type of glucose sensor which raised the alert. Constant (3) in every captured record;
090     * the meaning of other values is unconfirmed.
091     */
092    public int getSensorType() {
093        return sensorType;
094    }
095
096    /**
097     * Identifies what acknowledged the alert (e.g. pump GUI vs. a paired device). Field name is
098     * taken from tconnectsync's cloud-export schema; only value 0 (unacknowledged/default) and 1
099     * are present in the capture used to validate this field.
100     */
101    public long getAckSource() {
102        return ackSource;
103    }
104}
